points.description: States that zero voltage means there is no gap in the circuit at that point (equivalent wording, such as 'no voltage across a section means the circuit is complete there, so no break', earns the mark).

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that zero voltage indicates there is no gap (break) in the circuit at the point measured. No mark if the answer does not link zero voltage to the absence of a gap, or links it to the wrong meaning.
